plan.summary: Produce three Instagram reels, two story graphics, and captions for the winter menu launch with a focus on warm, modern aesthetics. Video shoots are required as photos exist but no footage has been captured.

deliverables.name: Instagram Reels
deliverables.notes: Warm, modern, festive vibe; no overt Christmas imagery

tasks.title: Confirm exact launch date with client
tasks.detail: Clarify 'next Friday' to establish absolute deadline for scheduling.

tasks.title: Schedule video shoot and capture footage
tasks.detail: Film new dishes using existing photos as reference; ensure warm lighting.

tasks.title: Edit reels and design story graphics
tasks.detail: Apply warm, modern filter; create two story assets.

tasks.title: Draft captions for all reels
tasks.detail: Write engaging copy matching the festive but non-specific tone.

tasks.title: Submit first draft of reels and graphics for client review
tasks.detail: Deliver all assets for approval; no publishing until signed off.

tasks.title: Finalize edits based on feedback and schedule posts
tasks.detail: Implement changes and set up Instagram publishing for launch day.

missing_inputs: What is the exact calendar date for 'next Friday'?

plan.summary: Produce a TikTok live, YouTube integration, and Instagram stories for lifestyle creator Maya, requiring script approval before her November travel dates. Key risks include missing talking points and unclear contract terms regarding usage rights and partnership labels.

deliverables.name: TikTok Live Stream
deliverables.notes: Must include brand integration and swipe-up link

deliverables.name: YouTube Video Integration
deliverables.notes: 60-90 second segment within regular vlog format

deliverables.name: Instagram Stories
deliverables.notes: Must include swipe-up link; verify paid-partnership label requirement

tasks.title: Review brand guidelines and contract terms
tasks.detail: Confirm usage rights, paid-partnership label requirements, and finalize script approval workflow.

tasks.title: Request talking points from brand
tasks.detail: Obtain specific talking points to ensure alignment with brand voice before filming.

tasks.title: Draft scripts for TikTok and YouTube segments
tasks.detail: Create initial drafts incorporating brand messaging and approved talking points.

tasks.title: Client review and script approval
tasks.detail: Submit scripts to Maya for approval; do not proceed to filming without signed-off scripts.

tasks.title: Plan shoot schedule around travel dates
tasks.detail: Schedule all filming for November 15-19 to avoid conflict with Maya's Nov 20-24 travel.

tasks.title: Execute TikTok live and YouTube shoot
tasks.detail: Film content according to approved scripts during scheduled window.

tasks.title: Edit TikTok video and YouTube segment
tasks.detail: Post-production editing for both video formats.

tasks.title: Design Instagram stories with swipe-up link
tasks.detail: Create story assets ensuring correct label usage based on contract review.

tasks.title: Schedule TikTok live and YouTube publish
tasks.detail: Finalize posting times for launch day.

missing_inputs: What is the exact date and time for the first TikTok live?
Does the contract require a paid-partnership label on Instagram stories?
Are there any specific brand messaging requirements beyond the provided guidelines?
risks: Maya's travel dates (Nov 20-24) limit available filming windows.
Unclear contract terms regarding usage rights and partnership labels.
Missing talking points could delay script approval and production start.
Tight turnaround time between script approval and live stream launch.

plan.summary: Produce a YouTube series launch including one episode, trailer, three shorts per episode, new thumbnail style, and channel banner. The project requires finalizing the series name, coordinating with an editor booked through the holidays, and confirming sponsor involvement.

tasks.title: Client review of all assets
tasks.detail: Present episode, trailer, shorts, and graphics for approval before scheduling.

tasks.title: Editing and post-production
tasks.detail: Edit episode, create trailer, and cut three shorts per episode.

tasks.title: Filming coordination with editor
tasks.detail: Schedule shoot dates accounting for editor's holiday booking.

tasks.title: Thumbnail and banner design
tasks.detail: Create new thumbnail style and channel banner using confirmed name.

tasks.title: Scriptwriting and storyboarding
tasks.detail: Draft script for episode and storyboard assets based on confirmed name.

tasks.title: Confirm series name and sponsor status
tasks.detail: Finalize the two proposed names and confirm if last month's sponsor is ready to join.

tasks.title: Scheduling and publishing
tasks.detail: Upload content to YouTube channels upon final approval.

missing_inputs: What are the two proposed series names?
Is the sponsor from last month confirmed for this launch?
What is the target launch date for January?
risks: Editor availability conflicts with holiday booking.
Uncertainty regarding the final series name affecting design direction.
Potential delay in sponsor confirmation impacting budget or content.
